description: Fork of exp314: swap out_proj BitPermutationLUT -> BitPermutationLUTEx. Ex routes votes into an output-table voting space V_ex = out_output_tph*2^out_output_nap, WTA per output table, scatter winner ±1 patterns to canonical pairs. Per-table routing for full kernel reuse via BitPermutationLUTVoting (Part 1) + BitPermutationLUTOptimizer unchanged. out_input_nap=6, out_input_tph=512, out_voting_nap=1024, out_output_nap=6, out_output_tph=512 → V_ex=32768, bit count per layer = 512*64*1024 = 33.6M bits.
